items.rationale: At romarr/app.py:5124-5126 the template binds separate item, source, and grabbed counts. The independent wording labels the two quantities explicitly; it is clearer than the compressed current clause and retains every placeholder.

items.target: गेम लाइब्रेरी की सूची
items.rationale: Both ledgers propose the same target. Ratify the shared target after the recorded placeholder and protected-term checks.

items.target: ゲームライブラリ一覧
items.rationale: romarr/ui.py:5663-5664 places this heading above the game-library inventory items. ゲームライブラリ一覧 is a natural section heading for that list and avoids a transliterated warehouse-style term.

items.target: قائمة الألعاب في المكتبة
items.rationale: romarr/ui.py:5663-5664 places this heading over the library item list. قائمة الألعاب في المكتبة describes the user-facing content directly; مخزون can suggest stock.

items.target: 게임 라이브러리 목록
items.rationale: romarr/ui.py:5663-5664 labels a list of the user's library items. 게임 라이브러리 목록 is clearer than an English-derived inventory loanword.

items.currentTarget: Danh sách kiểm kê thư viện trò chơi
items.target: Danh sách trò chơi trong thư viện
items.rationale: romarr/ui.py:5663-5664 heads the library inventory list. Danh sách trò chơi trong thư viện states what the screen lists and avoids the awkward audit sense of kiểm kê.

items.currentTarget: पुस्तकालय अभी भी लोड हो रहा है
items.target: गेम लाइब्रेरी अभी भी लोड हो रही है
items.rationale: The API reports this while the configured game library is loading (romarr/app.py:7148). The glossary defines Library as the user's game collection; गेम लाइब्रेरी avoids the public-library reading of पुस्तकालय.

items.currentTarget: 无法获取游戏库的游戏拥有状态
items.target: 无法获取游戏库中游戏的所有权信息
items.rationale: This error concerns unavailable ownership information for games in the library, not ownership of the library itself. The ownership lookup fallback is used at romarr/ui.py:2374 and 2482; the primary proposal states that meaning directly.

items.currentTarget: Der Besitzstatus der Spielebibliothek ist nicht verfügbar
items.target: Der Besitzstatus der Spiele in der Bibliothek lässt sich nicht ermitteln.
items.rationale: The ownership lookup fallback at romarr/ui.py:2374 and 2482 concerns games in the collection. Der Besitzstatus der Spiele in der Bibliothek lässt sich nicht ermitteln removes the ambiguity that the current compound describes ownership of the library.

items.currentTarget: 無法取得遊戲庫的遊戲持有狀態
items.target: 無法取得遊戲庫中遊戲的擁有資訊
items.rationale: The fallback at romarr/ui.py:2374 and 2482 is about ownership data for games in the library. The primary wording says that directly rather than implying ownership of the library as a whole.

items.target: {library} nicht erreichbar ({error_type})
items.rationale: The UI formats an endpoint/library reachability diagnostic at romarr/ui.py:1065-1067. Nicht erreichbar is idiomatic for unreachable; unzugänglich suggests inaccessible.

items.target: Probablemente un conjunto de varios discos · revisar
items.rationale: romarr/ui.py:5754 uses this as a compact multi-disc classification with a review cue. The independent wording translates the term naturally and preserves both likelihood and review.

items.rationale: romarr/ui.py:5754 uses this as a likely multi-disc classification requiring review. The independent proposal translates the English-heavy set label and preserves uncertainty.

items.rationale: At romarr/ui.py:5754 the label marks a likely set for review. Có khả năng là preserves the stronger likelihood cue more closely than Có thể là; cần xem lại translates the action.

items.target: Kemungkinan set berisi beberapa disk · perlu ditinjau
items.rationale: romarr/ui.py:5754 is a status label, not a rating. The independent wording makes the multi-disc meaning and review-needed status explicit in Indonesian.

items.rationale: Both reviews propose the same label for the hours field at romarr/ui.py:4475. It fixes the current awkward word order and spacing; retain refinement rather than correction because the current wording remains understandable.

items.rationale: romarr/ui.py:2537 labels a display mode beside Cover view. Visualização em lista names the mode more naturally than the current Visão da lista, which reads as a view of a particular list.
